result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back from all six listing and lookup paths. The full offline suite passes (608 tests, including the new one).

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(255)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` added as the last record component. Null means no description.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new overload `createPromotion(code, discount, start, end, category, description)`. A null or blank description is stored as null. The existing 5-argument method delegates to it, so current callers are unchanged.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the description. The active, active-in-region, by-category, best-for-category, unused, and by-code queries select it and map it. Nothing else in `DataStore` was touched.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `carriesDescriptionOfPromotionInAllListings` test. It creates SUMMER with a description and PLAIN without one, then checks each path.

Because I added the description as the last record component, any code outside this repo that calls `new Promotion(...)` with six arguments will need updating. Inside the repo, all constructor calls are updated.
